terms.gloss: move (a plant) to another place, transplant
evidence: Varr. RR 1.39.3: sēmina, quae trānsferuntur ē terrā in terram (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 13.37: plantāria īnstituunt anniculāsque trānsferunt (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The gardeners’ use of the ordinary verb for carrying across; also of transferring by grafting (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: sēmina, quae trānsferuntur ē terrā in terram
phrases.english: seedlings that are moved from one soil to another

sources: Lewis & Short: transfero · Lewis & Short: plantarium
